verdict.rationale: The Agent API is explicitly designed around natural-language 'instructions' and 'input' fields, presets, and MCP integration so AI assistants and agents can drive the product purely via NL commands rather than rigid code paths, and the CLI/MCP server extend this to terminal and agent-tool contexts. missing for 10: independent or hands-on third-party verification that NL-driven agent behavior works reliably in practice, and no evidence of a conversational end-user interface beyond API/CLI/MCP docs.
